customer_zero_journeys.outcome: An experienced builder describes an intention, compares a deterministic compiled result, and saves an artifact they can reuse.

criteria.requirement: Intent text compiles to a versioned structured prompt contract.
Malformed, refused, empty, slow, unavailable, and oversized model responses are handled without corrupting application state.
criteria.claim: Application correctness is independent of live model behavior.

criteria.requirement: Create, inspect, save, terminate, relaunch, edit, and diff a prompt contract.
criteria.claim: The critical versioning journey is unattended.

criteria.requirement: Evaluation runs produce repeatable structured results for a fixed fixture set.
criteria.claim: Evaluation and regression detection are reproducible.

criteria.requirement: Critical journey renders semantic screenshots and machine-accessible controls.
criteria.claim: Visual and machine-observable accessibility regressions are detected.

criteria.requirement: Import and export preserve the prompt contract, version identity, and evaluation metadata.
criteria.claim: Portable artifacts round-trip without silent loss.

criteria.requirement: Live model behavior remains within the product's quality and safety evaluation envelope.
criteria.claim: A changing live model remains useful for the declared quality claim.

escape.why_automation_is_insufficient: Deterministic doubles prove application handling but cannot establish changing live-model quality.
escape.physical_or_empirical_property: Live model output quality across OS/model versions.

criteria.requirement: The exact software artifact is signed and released only with owner authorization.

escape.why_automation_is_insufficient: Signing and publication are irreversible governance operations.
escape.physical_or_empirical_property: Human authorization and external distribution effect.
